name: Manila Ocean Park
local_transportation: LRT to UN Avenue; walking from Rizal Park
activities: Oceanarium; attraction packages
fee_operational_notes: Oceanarium-only ~₱680–750 online; 8-attraction package ~₱950–1,000; walk-in higher. Promos change often.
hours_note: Weekends and holidays open from 9am per site footer. Last admission about 45 min before close.

name: San Agustin Church and Museum
activities: UNESCO church; museum galleries
fee_operational_notes: Church worship free; ₱200 museum adult, ₱160 students/seniors/PWD.
hours_note: Split day 08:00–12:00 / 13:00–17:00 (closed midday).

name: Manila Cathedral (Minor Basilica of the Immaculate Conception)
activities: Cathedral visit; Mass
fee_operational_notes: Free entry for visits and Mass.
hours_note: Grounds window from guides; Masses Mon–Fri 07:30 and 12:10, Sat 07:30, Sun 08:00/10:00/18:00. Office Tue–Sat, closed Mon.

name: Binondo Church (Minor Basilica of St. Lorenzo Ruiz)
local_transportation: LRT to Carriedo; walking in Chinatown
activities: Church visit; Chinatown food walk
fee_operational_notes: Free; donations welcome.
hours_note: Grounds window from guides. Masses Mon–Sat 07:00/12:15/17:00; Sun 08:30/10:00/12:15/17:00 per parish.

name: National Museum of Natural History
local_transportation: LRT to UN Avenue; Rizal Park complex
activities: Museum galleries; Tree of Life atrium
fee_operational_notes: Free admission per NMP visitor guidelines. Groups of 20+ need advance booking.
hours_note: Closed Mondays per Jan-2024 guidelines; a 2025 annex says daily — re-verify. Arrive 30 min before close.

name: Mt. Samat National Shrine (Dambana ng Kagitingan)
local_transportation: Bus to Balanga then jeep to Pilar
activities: Colonnade and cross; WWII museum (availability varies)
fee_operational_notes: ₱20–50 per PVAO advisory. Fees fund maintenance.
hours_note: Entry cut-off 4pm per PVAO advisory. Museum availability varies.

name: Monasterio de Tarlac
local_transportation: Bus to Tarlac City then jeep to San Jose
activities: Pilgrimage; 30-ft Risen Christ; views
fee_operational_notes: ₱50 gate fee widely reported but inconsistently; no official fee page. Re-verify on site.
hours_note: Closed Thursdays. Pilgrim Mass 10:30 daily except Thu; Sundays also 3pm. Houses a relic of the True Cross.

name: Manaoag Church (Minor Basilica of Our Lady of Manaoag)
activities: Pilgrimage; blessing of vehicles and religious articles
fee_operational_notes: Free.
hours_note: Mass schedule only published; no closing time stated. First Mass about 5am; last Sunday Mass 4:30pm. Very crowded weekends and feasts.

name: Barasoain Church (Our Lady of Mt. Carmel Parish)
local_transportation: Bus to Malolos; tricycle to San Gabriel
entrance_fee_display: Free; museum free or minimal donation
activities: Historic church; Museo ng Republika ng 1899
fee_operational_notes: Church free. NHCP museum fee uncertain — reported free or minimal.
hours_note: Church window from guides. Museum Tue–Sun 08:00–16:00 per parish listings. Cradle of the First Philippine Republic.

name: Ma-Cho Temple
local_transportation: Jeepney along Quezon Ave, San Fernando
activities: Taoist temple; panoramic sea views
fee_operational_notes: Free entry. Dress code: no shorts, sleeveless or revealing clothes.
hours_note: First Taoist temple in the country (1970s), dedicated to sea-goddess Mazu.

name: Sky Ranch Tagaytay
local_transportation: Bus to Tagaytay; jeep along Nasugbu highway
activities: Rides; Sky Eye Ferris wheel; views
fee_operational_notes: ₱120 admission only; rides ₱60–350 each or ride-all-you-can pass separately; senior ₱96.
hours_note: Hours conflict across sources (mall-tenant schedule vs park guides). Confirm via official page before visiting. Coordinates from photo EXIF — verify pin.

name: People's Park in the Sky
local_transportation: Jeepney to Sungay; steep walk or tricycle up
activities: Viewpoint; unfinished palace ruins
fee_operational_notes: Most reports ₱30; some 2024–2026 reports ₱50 adult. Parking extra.
hours_source_label: Wondering Wanderer guide and park signage
hours_note: Open daily 6am–7pm per park signage and visitor reports. Highest point in Tagaytay.

name: Caleruega Church (Transfiguration Chapel)
local_transportation: Bus to Nasugbu; tricycle to Kaylaway
activities: Chapel; gardens; retreat grounds
fee_operational_notes: ₱30/person maintenance; parking ~₱40. Retreat and wedding venue — check schedule.
hours_note: Exact window varies across listings (6:00–17:30 to 8:00–17:00). Sunday chapel Mass 11am.

name: Corregidor Island
local_transportation: Organized tour only; no regular public Manila ferry
entrance_fee_display: Island entry ₱300; practical visit needs tour package ~₱2,250–₱2,999+
typical_food_drinks: Tour lunch included in most packages
activities: Guided island tour; WWII ruins and tunnels
fee_operational_notes: Entry ₱300/pax (PWD/senior/student ~₱214); tramvia and guide extra. Practical cost is the package. Terminal fee ~₱30.
hours_note: Island under management transition; access via Bataan tour operators, guided day-tour only. Verify with operator; bring own food. Hours tour-dependent.

name: Pagsanjan Falls (Magdapio Falls)
local_transportation: Boat from Pagsanjan town; jump-off in Cavinti
activities: Shooting-the-rapids canoe with two bankeros
fee_operational_notes: 2026 reports ₱1,200/boat (max 3) + ₱250 entry + ₱700 solo surcharge; older packages ₱1,450–1,500/pax. Confirm with tourism office.
possible_expenses: boat rental; entrance/environmental fee; guide/bankero tip
hours_note: Boat route roughly 7/8am–5pm. Water levels can close the lagoon run — call ahead. Falls sit in Pagsanjan Gorge; trips start from Pagsanjan town.

name: Villa Escudero Plantations and Resort
local_transportation: Shuttle from San Pablo or private van; Km 91 Tiaong
activities: Museum; bamboo rafting; waterfall restaurant; cultural show
fee_operational_notes: Promo day-tour ₱1,600 weekday / ₱1,800–1,950 weekend; child half-rate. Standard rates higher; pre-booking required.
hours_note: Day-tour gate hours not published; daytime resort operation. Do not invent times.

name: Kamay ni Hesus Shrine
local_transportation: Bus to Lucban; tricycle to Tinamnan
activities: 305-step climb to 50-ft Risen Christ; Healing Mass
fee_operational_notes: No fixed entrance fee; donations welcome.
hours_note: Listings vary 6:00–18:00 vs 7:00–17:00; upper sections may close 4:30pm. Healing Mass Wed and Sat about 9:30am.

name: Puzzle Mansion
activities: Guinness puzzle collection museum
fee_operational_notes: ₱100/head; kids 3 and below free; senior ~₱80.
hours_note: Some reports say closed Tue–Wed; others open daily 8am–6pm. Also a bed and breakfast. Confirm via page.

name: Fantasy World
local_transportation: Bus to Lemery; tricycle to site
typical_food_drinks: Bring food; no major stalls inside
activities: Abandoned castle photo park (no operational rides)
fee_operational_notes: ₱100/pax or ₱1,000/group of 10 when open. No rides — photo park only.
hours_note: Multiple 2021–2026 reports say temporarily or permanently closed. Verify on the ground before visiting.

name: Mt. Arayat National Park
local_transportation: Bus to Arayat; tricycle to trailhead
activities: Day hike with mandatory guide (1,026m north peak)
fee_operational_notes: Old figures ₱25–75 entry + guide ₱700/5 pax (2018); current fees unverified. Cottages extra. Two trailheads: Magalang/PSAU north, Arayat south.
hours_note: No official gate hours found; climbs start about 6:00–6:30am daylight. Protected landscape since 1933. Verify fees on site.

name: Malacañang of the North
activities: Marcos-era mansion museum; Chinese Garden
fee_operational_notes: Adult ₱70, children free, SC/student ₱50, DAP free. Older guides cite ₱30 — the provincial page governs.
hours_source_label: Ilocos Norte Tourism — Attractions and Fees
hours_note: Provincial government rate 2026.

name: Baluarte Resort and Mini Zoo
activities: Mini zoo; safari gallery (separately ticketed)
fee_operational_notes: General admission reported free; e-cab/shuttle ₱50 per head; Safari Gallery separately ticketed. One 2023 post claims ₱50 entrance — verify on site or page.
hours_note: No LGU-posted hours found; guides report 8am–5pm. Verify on the official page before publishing hours.

name: Bantay Bell Tower
activities: Hilltop belfry viewpoint
fee_operational_notes: No entrance fee; donations accepted (guides suggest ~₱50).
hours_note: Ungated hillside belfry; no posted hours. Guides claim daylight access — unverified, do not publish as hours.

name: Basco Lighthouse (Naidi Hills)
typical_food_drinks: Tour lunch included in most packages
activities: Lighthouse viewpoint; Naidi Hills
fee_operational_notes: No gate fee. All Batanes visitors pay ₱405 provincial registration (EO 23 s.2026) regardless.
hours_note: Ungated viewpoint, no LGU gate hours. Registration via provincial booking site mandatory.

name: Marlboro Hills (Racuh A Payaman)
typical_food_drinks: Tour lunch included in most packages
activities: Communal pasture viewpoint
fee_operational_notes: Free access via South Batan circuit. Provincial ₱405 registration applies. OSM node falls in Uyugan but every tour source lists Mahatao.
hours_note: Ungated pasture, no posted hours. Guides recommend early morning or late afternoon for light and wind.

name: Valugan Boulder Beach
typical_food_drinks: Tour lunch included in most packages
activities: Boulder shoreline at sunrise
fee_operational_notes: Free entry; protected landmark. Provincial ₱405 registration applies.
hours_note: Ungated shoreline, no posted hours. Best at sunrise (east-facing). No swimming — Pacific undercurrents; rock removal prohibited.

name: Inflatable Island PH
local_transportation: Bus to Olongapo; jeep to Barretto
activities: Floating water park; beach club
fee_operational_notes: 2025 rates: Beach Club ₱899 (₱500 consumable), Spray half-day ~₱1,299, Soaked whole-day ~₱1,399. 2026 reports higher. Confirm on booking page. Pin approximate — verify on map.
hours_note: Open daily 7:30am–6pm per official site; some posts say 8am — the site governs.

name: Quezon Memorial Circle
local_transportation: MRT to North Avenue; short walk
entrance_fee_display: Free; museum and zipline priced separately
typical_food_drinks: Food trucks and weekend markets on-site
activities: Bike and picnic grounds; Quezon Memorial Museum; zipline; night market
fee_operational_notes: Grounds free. The museum inside the monument keeps its own admission; zipline and bike stalls price on-site.
possible_expenses: ground transport; food/drinks; optional activity rentals
hours_note: City-run public park, ungated. The museum inside the monument keeps its own hours; zipline and bike stalls keep theirs.

name: Manila Zoological and Botanical Garden
local_transportation: LRT-1 to Quirino Avenue; jeepney or walk
activities: Animal exhibits; lagoon boating; botanical garden
fee_operational_notes: Entrance ₱100 standard, ₱50 with proof of Manila residency. 2022 reopening rates; confirm at the gate.
hours_note: Reopened 2022 after renovation. Gate hours published on city channels rather than a fixed page — verify before travelling.

name: SM Mall of Asia Bay Area
local_transportation: EDSA bus or MRT to EDSA-Taft; shuttle
typical_food_drinks: Every price band; food court to seaside dining
activities: Seaside boulevard; ferris wheel; ice rink; sunset walk
fee_operational_notes: Grounds and seaside free. Ferris wheel, ice rink and rides price on-site.
possible_expenses: ground transport; food/drinks; optional attraction tickets
hours_note: Mall grounds keep mall hours; the seaside boulevard itself is ungated. Attractions have their own schedules.

name: Manila Baywalk Dolomite Beach
local_transportation: LRT-1 to United Nations; walk or jeepney
activities: Sunset viewing; dolomite shoreline walk
fee_operational_notes: Free entry. Swimming prohibited; segment closures along Roxas Boulevard happen during bay cleanups and events.
hours_note: Ungated public beach on the baywalk, no posted hours. Closures during cleanups and typhoon swell are reported locally.

name: Wawa Dam (Montalban Gorge)
local_transportation: Jeepney from Cubao to Rodriguez; tricycle to site
typical_food_drinks: Bring food; small carinderias near the site
activities: Gorge and limestone views; raft rides; river picnic
fee_operational_notes: ₱20 environmental fee at the barangay desk. Raft rides priced per head on-site. Day use only.
hours_note: Day-use site with no published gate hours. Tricycles stop at the trailhead; the last stretch is a walk.

name: Avilon Zoo
local_transportation: Jeepney to Rodriguez; tricycle to site
activities: Guided wildlife tours; feeding sessions
fee_operational_notes: Entrance with guided tour 2025 rates. Group and guided-tour pricing changes; confirm by booking before travelling.
hours_note: Philippines' largest zoological institution by collection. Visits are guided and scheduled — reservation ahead is the norm.

name: Sarrat Church (Santa Monica Parish Church)
local_transportation: Bus to Batac or Laoag; jeepney to Sarrat
activities: Baroque church; convent ruins; heritage walk
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active parish. Mass schedule governs visiting; tourist visits avoid mass times.
hours_note: Largest church in Ilocos Norte and the 1983 wedding site of Marcos. No published gate hours; the parish office can confirm visiting times.

name: Batac Riverside Empanada Lane
local_transportation: Bus to Batac; tricycle to the riverside lane
typical_food_drinks: Batac empanada ₱50–₱100 each; miki noodle soup
activities: Orange empanada tasting; miki noodles; evening food walk
fee_operational_notes: Stalls are individually run and price per piece. The lane is busiest from late afternoon into the evening.
hours_note: Home of the orange empanada. Stalls keep their own hours; the lane is a food stop rather than a ticketed site.

name: Paoay Lake National Park
local_transportation: Jeepney from Laoag to Paoay; tricycle around the lake
activities: Lakeside birdwatching; viewpoint walk; Malacañang of the North sits on the shore
fee_operational_notes: Free access as a declared national park. No gate or published hours; the lakeshore road is public.
hours_note: Ungated lake with public shoreline access. Pairs naturally with Malacañang of the North and the church in one loop.

name: Imus Cathedral (Our Lady of the Pillar Parish)
local_transportation: Bus to Imus; jeepney to the plaza
activities: Historic parish church; plaza walk; heritage marker
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active cathedral. Mass schedule governs visiting; heritage markers around the plaza.
hours_note: Seat of the Diocese of Imus and a Battle of Alapan heritage anchor. No published tourist hours; visit outside mass times.

name: Cavite City Waterfront (Julian Felipe Monument)
local_transportation: Bus or jeepney from Baclaran via Bacoor
activities: Bayside walk; Julian Felipe Monument (composer of the national anthem); historic markers
fee_operational_notes: Free public waterfront. No gate or published hours; sunset is the recommended time.
hours_note: Ungated public esplanade honouring the birthplace of the Philippine anthem. Closures during coastal works are posted locally. Pin placed at the OpenStreetMap Julian Felipe Monument node.

name: Kaybiang Tunnel
local_transportation: Bus to Naic; jeepney to Ternate; habal to the ridge
typical_food_drinks: Bring food; sari-sari stores at the trailhead
activities: Hand-carved mountain tunnel; Ternate ridge viewpoint; gateway to Nasugbu beaches
fee_operational_notes: Free passage; the tunnel is an active road. Park at the pull-offs and walk the ridge edge for the view.
hours_note: The country's longest hand-carved tunnel, on the Ternate–Nasugbu road. No published hours — it is a public road; pass in daylight.

name: Santa Maria Church (Nuestra Señora de la Asunción)
local_transportation: Bus along the Manila–Vigan road to Santa Maria; tricycle to the hill
activities: UNESCO baroque church on a hill; 85-step stone stairway; convent ruins
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active parish and UNESCO World Heritage church; mass schedule governs visiting.
hours_note: One of the four Philippine baroque churches on the UNESCO list. No published tourist hours; visit outside mass times.

name: Baluarte Watchtower (Toro Hill)
local_transportation: Tricycle from Vigan city centre up the hill
activities: Hilltop watchtower above the zoo grounds; Unesco-city panorama
fee_operational_notes: The tower itself is free; it sits above the Baluarte zoo property which keeps its own hours.
hours_note: Confirm the property's visiting hours locally; the tower viewpoint is a short climb from the parking area.

name: Vigan Cathedral (St. Paul Metropolitan Cathedral)
activities: 1780s earthquake-baroque cathedral; Salcedo plaza; bell tower across the street
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active cathedral; mass schedule governs visiting.
hours_note: Heart of the UNESCO heritage city. No published tourist hours; visit outside mass times.

name: Pagburnayan Jar Factory
activities: Working burnay jar workshop; potter demonstrations; throw your own clay
fee_operational_notes: Free entry to the workshop; clay-throwing is typically tipped or a small jar purchase.
possible_expenses: local transport; optional jar purchase; food/drinks
hours_note: Working pottery yard with caretaker hours rather than a posted gate schedule.

name: Bessang Pass Monument
local_transportation: Bus to Cervantes (long mountain road); habal to the pass
activities: Memorial to the 1945 battle that broke the Japanese defense of northern Luzon; ridge panorama
fee_operational_notes: Free memorial site on the mountain pass; the journey is the cost.
hours_note: Remote roadside monument with no published hours. Pin placed at the OpenStreetMap Bessang Pass National Shrine node.

name: Quirino Bridge (Banaoang Bridge)
local_transportation: Tricycle from Vigan toward Bantay; viewpoint on the old bridge approach
activities: Old steel truss bridge over the Abra River; sunset views from the new parallel bridge
fee_operational_notes: Free roadside viewpoint; the decommissioned span remains as a landmark.
hours_note: Roadside landmark, ungated and unlit — visit in daylight. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Quezon National Forest Park (Quezon Protected Landscape)
local_transportation: Bus to Atimonan; tricycle to the Atimonan Zigzag Park jump-off
activities: Mt. Pinagbanderahan (Mt. Mirador) hike; Bantakay Falls; Bantakay and Cueva Santa caves; Niyugan campsite
fee_operational_notes: Free to enter. Trail guides are arranged at the Atimonan Zigzag Park.
hours_note: No official hours published. Entry is free; the stores at Atimonan Zigzag Park close around 18:00–19:00.

name: Alibijabin-adjacent Cagbalete Island
local_transportation: Bus to Mauban; boat from Mauban port to the island
activities: Long white-sand flats at low tide; sandbar walks; village homestays
fee_operational_notes: Boat fare from Mauban port plus barangay fees and homestay rates; everything is arranged on the spot.
possible_expenses: boat fare; barangay fee; homestay; food/drinks
hours_note: Island barangay with no published gate hours; boats run in daylight by arrangement. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Baluti Island
local_transportation: Bus to Real, Quezon; banca from the Infanta/Real shore
activities: Small island camp site off Real; drift snorkelling on clear days
fee_operational_notes: Cost is the banca hire shared per group; the island itself is ungated.
hours_note: No published hours; banca trips run in daylight, weather permitting. Pin placed on Baluti Island, off Real.

name: Boruangan Falls (Bantakay area)
local_transportation: Bus to Atimonan; habal to the Bantakay trailhead
activities: Forest waterfall inside the Quezon Protected Landscape approach; mossy gorge
fee_operational_notes: Barangay guide fee and small trail contribution; access is community-managed.
hours_note: Community-managed falls with no published hours or fixed fee; confirm at the barangay hall. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Malagonlong Bridge (Tayabas)
local_transportation: Jeepney from Lucena to Tayabas; walk or tricycle to the bridge
activities: Spanish-era five-span stone bridge; national cultural treasure; river walk
fee_operational_notes: Free Spanish-era stone bridge, a declared national cultural treasure; still walkable.
hours_note: Roadside landmark, ungated and unlit — visit in daylight.

name: Basilica Minore of St. Michael the Archangel (Tayabas)
activities: One of the oldest and largest churches in Quezon; coral-stone facade; plaza
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active minor basilica; mass schedule governs visiting.
hours_note: No published tourist hours; visit outside mass times.

name: Chawa Viewdeck
local_transportation: North Batan or South Batan tour van; habal from Basco
activities: Cliffside zigzag road down to the sea; sunrise viewpoint over the west coast
fee_operational_notes: Free roadside viewpoint on the Mahatao zigzag.
hours_note: Ungated viewpoint, no posted hours; best at sunrise. No gate — it is the road itself.

name: Racuh A Idi (Valugan side) Songsong Ruins
local_transportation: South Batan tour van; habal from Basco
activities: Abandoned songsong (stone house) settlements; wind-carved coastal valley
fee_operational_notes: Free site within the Uyugan coast road; the ₱405 provincial registration covers all visitors.
hours_note: Ungated ruins along the south road; no posted hours. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Alapad Pass and Hill
local_transportation: South Batan tour van; habal from Basco
activities: The narrow pass between the Pacific and the South China Sea; wind-carved grass hills
fee_operational_notes: Free roadside viewpoint; the ₱405 provincial registration covers all visitors.
hours_note: Ungated pass on the south Batan road; no posted hours; extremely windy — mind the edge.

name: Huhmurun (Diptan) Stone Beach
local_transportation: South Batan tour van; habal from Basco
activities: Smooth white boulder beach; Ivatan stone-house village backdrop
fee_operational_notes: Free shoreline; the ₱405 provincial registration covers all visitors.
hours_note: Ungated boulder beach near Diptan village; no posted hours. No swimming in the open Pacific swell.

name: San Jose de Obrero Church (Diptan)
local_transportation: South Batan tour van; habal from Basco
activities: 1787 Ivatan coral-stone church; national cultural treasure
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active parish; mass schedule governs visiting.
hours_note: Ivatan heritage church with no published tourist hours; visit outside mass times.

name: Savidug Stone Houses and Idjang
local_transportation: Boat from Ivana to Sabtang; tricycle around the island
entrance_fee_display: Free; provincial registration ₱405/person; Sabtang eco fee ~₱100
activities: Best-preserved Ivatan stone-house village; idjang fortress hill above it
fee_operational_notes: Sabtang barangay eco fee at the port; homestay meals arranged on the island.
possible_expenses: provincial registration; eco fee; boat fare; food/drinks
hours_note: Village visit with no published hours; the eco fee is collected at the Sabtang port. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Chamantad-Tiñan Viewpoint
local_transportation: Boat from Ivana to Sabtang; tricycle to the coast road
entrance_fee_display: Free; provincial registration ₱405/person; Sabtang eco fee ~₱100
activities: Green cliffs dropping to a cove; the most photographed Sabtang panorama
fee_operational_notes: Free viewpoint along the Sabtang coast road; the eco fee is collected at the port.
possible_expenses: provincial registration; eco fee; boat fare; food/drinks
hours_note: Ungated coastal viewpoint; no posted hours; the coastal walk continues to Nakabuang arch. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Borawan Island
local_transportation: Bus to Padre Burgos; boat from the barangay port
activities: Limestone cliffs over a sand beach; kayak camping; island-hopping hub
fee_operational_notes: Barangay environmental fee, cottage rates and boat hire arranged at the port; rates are set locally.
possible_expenses: boat fare; environmental fee; cottage rental; food/drinks
hours_note: Island beach with no published gate hours; boats run in daylight by arrangement. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Ermita Hill
activities: Tsunami memorial; viewdeck over Baler Bay; picnic huts
fee_operational_notes: Small eco fee at the entrance. Site of the Ermita mothers' memorial to the 1735 tsunami that erased the old Baler settlement.
hours_note: Ungated hilltop park on the north side of Baler Bay; no published gate hours. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Diguisit Bay Rock Formations
local_transportation: Tricycle from Baler north along the coast road
typical_food_drinks: Bring food; small carinderias on the coast road
activities: Aniao islets at low tide; wave-carved rock formations; sunrise
fee_operational_notes: Free shoreline access; cottage and hut rentals priced on-site.
possible_expenses: local transport; food/drinks; optional cottage rental
hours_note: Ungated rocky cove with no posted hours; best at low tide for the islets.

name: Ampere Beach
local_transportation: Jeepney north from Baler to Dipaculao; walk to shore
activities: Smooth rock shelves; wave watching; rock pools
fee_operational_notes: Free shoreline; local cottage fees occasionally collected by the barangay.
hours_note: Ungated cobble-and-rock beach north of Baler; no published hours. Big surf makes swimming unsafe most days.

name: Balete Park and Millennium Tree
local_transportation: Jeepney from Baler to Maria Aurora; tricycle to the park
activities: 600-year-old balete tree; climb into the trunk; park picnic grounds
fee_operational_notes: Small park fee; a local guide takes visitors up into the tree for a tip.
hours_note: Ungated roadside park; no published hours — visits are daytime by custom.

name: Baler Church (San Luis Obispo de Tolosa Parish)
activities: 1859 stone church; Siege of Baler heritage; plaza walk
fee_operational_notes: Free entry as an active parish; mass schedule governs visiting.
hours_note: The last Spanish redoubt of the 1898–99 Siege of Baler. No published tourist hours; visit outside mass times.

name: Mt. Maculot
local_transportation: Bus to Cuenca; tricycle to the jump-off
activities: Rockies viewpoint over Taal Lake; summit camp; day hike
fee_operational_notes: Barangay registration at the Cuenca jump-off; guides mandatory and priced per group.
hours_note: Classic Taal dayhike. No published gate hours — trailheads open from first light by custom; confirm current fees at the registration desk.

name: Masasa Beach
local_transportation: Bus to Batangas City; boat to Tingloy
activities: White shoreline; snorkelling; village homestays
fee_operational_notes: Barangay environmental fees and cottage rates vary; boats from the mainland are priced per trip. Confirm at the Tingloy barangay hall.
possible_expenses: boat fare; environmental fee; homestay; food/drinks
hours_note: No published gate hours — an island barangay beach, not a resort gate. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: The Farm at San Benito
local_transportation: Private transfer from Manila; or bus to Lipa and a hired car
typical_food_drinks: Wellness cuisine on-site; resort dining only
activities: Vegan wellness resort; jungle pools; healing spa treatments; day retreats
fee_operational_notes: Award-winning wellness resort; day passes and overnight packages change often — confirm on the official site before travelling.
hours_note: Reservation required — walk-ins are not the norm. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Casa Villavicencio
local_transportation: Bus to Taal town proper; walk the heritage streets
activities: 1870s ancestral house museum; heritage street walk
fee_operational_notes: Donation-based entry to the restored ancestral house beside the Villavicencio wedding gift house.
hours_note: Heritage house museums keep caretaker hours rather than posted ones — confirm locally on the day.

name: Mt. Daguldol
local_transportation: Bus to San Juan, Batangas; jeepney or habal to Hugom
typical_food_drinks: Bring food; Hugom village sari-sari stores
activities: Coastal-to-summit dayhike; Batangas coastline views; camp on the shoulder
fee_operational_notes: Barangay registration at the Hugom jump-off; guides mandatory. The trailhead starts beside the beach — many hikers swim after.
hours_note: No published gate hours; trailhead opens at first light. Pin approximate — verify on map.

name: Pundaquit Beach
